## Clause 2, enterprise half — MEASURED. No self-registrant is auto-joined, and the card's stated reason is the wrong one.

`repo:cloud` execution seat, dispatched by the PM (seat post #6026, round R35), session `session_017Wu48ZSjk7HJjyJmGNBtUk`.

**Refs read.** cloud `main` at `58c20e2` (worktree base; the reading is unchanged at my head `a347a59`, which adds only a test). Framework at the cloud pin `.objectstack-sha` = `655b106ce2804d2cdb9ed4386df795152535d372`, checked out detached as the sibling `link:` target the cloud manifests resolve to.

**Answer up front.** Clause 2 holds for the enterprise package. But the derivation this card proposed — "#11211 removed the admin grant, the bootstrap re-runs after every admin grant, so the trigger goes with it" — is **false as to the trigger**, and this card was right that it needed measuring rather than inferring. On a walled box the enterprise bootstrap **is registration-triggered**. Clause 2 survives because the helper is **admin-keyed**, not first-registrant-keyed.

---

### 1. The enterprise packages contain no membership writer at all

```
$ grep -rn "sys_member" packages/organizations packages/security-enterprise
```

31 hits across both packages, **every one a comment, a type field, a constant, a read, or a test double**. The only executable uses are reads:

```
packages/security-enterprise/src/hierarchy/org-membership.ts:55:export const MEMBERSHIP_OBJECT = 'sys_member';
packages/security-enterprise/src/hierarchy/org-membership.ts:85:    const found = await engine.find(MEMBERSHIP_OBJECT, {
```

`packages/organizations` has **zero** `sys_member` occurrences of any kind, and creates no `sys_organization` row of its own:

```
$ grep -rn "sys_organization" packages/organizations packages/security-enterprise --include=*.ts | grep -v ".test.ts"
packages/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts:314:          'sys_organization',      ← ql.find, limit 2, counting orgs
packages/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts:297:        opCtx?.object !== 'sys_organization' ||
```

The write seams in `claim-org-seed-ownership.ts` and `claim-orphan-org-rows.ts` are `ql.update` only (re-stamping `owner_id` / `organization_id` on already-existing rows) — no insert exists in either file.

⇒ Every organization/membership WRITE this package can cause happens inside the framework helper it delegates to, `ensureDefaultOrganization` from `@objectstack/plugin-auth`.

**Controls — the grep does reach a population that inserts.** Three deliberate `sys_member` inserters exist in this repo and the grep finds all three, so a clean read above is a fact about these two packages and not about the pattern:

```
packages/service-cloud/src/personal-org-hook.ts:343:        await driver.create('sys_member', {   ← control-plane personal-org provisioning
packages/objectos-runtime/src/environment-org-seed.ts:144:            await ql.insert('sys_member', {
objectstack packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/reconcile-membership.ts:196: await engine.insert('sys_member', …)  ← the invitation / auto-join reconciler
```

---

### 2. Per-trigger table (enterprise wiring, cloud `58c20e2` over pin `655b106c`)

| # | Trigger site | Fires on | Gate in force | Can it join a self-registrant? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `organizations-plugin.ts:425` `ctx.hook('kernel:ready', runEnsure)` | **boot** | `this.opts.ensureDefaultOrganization` only — ⚠️ **no posture gate here**, by design | No. Runs before any user exists; and the helper is admin-keyed (row 3). |
| 2 | `organizations-plugin.ts:444-449` middleware ⇒ `isDefaultOrganizationBootstrapTrigger(opCtx)` | **`sys_user` insert**, `sys_user` update touching `email`/`email_verified`, `sys_user_permission_set` insert | none beyond the predicate | ⚠️ **The trigger DOES fire on a self-registrant's registration.** The refusal is downstream, at row 3. |
| 3 | pin `ensure-default-organization.ts:291-316` — anchor resolution | (called by 1 and 2) | config anchor: `matchesConfiguredPlatformAdmin` = declared `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` **and** `email_verified`; else legacy anchor: oldest **unscoped** `admin_full_access` grant | **No.** A self-registrant matches neither ⇒ `reason: 'no_admin'`, no write. |
| 4 | pin `ensure-default-organization.ts:320-327` | (called by 1 and 2) | existing `sys_member` for the admin ⇒ `admin_already_in_org` | No — this only suppresses further writes. |
| 5 | `organizations-plugin.ts:294` seed-pipeline middleware, `sys_organization` insert | org creation | — | No. Replays seed datasets / claims orphan rows; `ql.update` only, never a membership. |
| 6 | `organizations-plugin.ts:257` auto-stamp middleware, any insert | any insert | `isSystem` short-circuit | No. Stamps `organization_id` on a row someone else is inserting. |
| 7 | `membership-policy-gate.ts` ⇒ `kernel:bootstrapped` | boot | walled + undeclared policy ⇒ **refuses the boot** | No — this is the gate that forces the deployment to declare `invite-only` at all (cloud#1092). |

Row 2 is the correction this card exists to obtain. Verbatim, pin `655b106c`:

```ts
// packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/ensure-default-organization.ts:203
export function isDefaultOrganizationBootstrapTrigger(opCtx: {…}): boolean {
  const op = opCtx?.operation;
  if (opCtx?.object === 'sys_user') {
    if (op === 'create' || op === 'insert') return true;
```

and its own comment says why the grant-shaped reading is stale:

> `sys_user_permission_set` insert/create — the LEGACY anchor's trigger … This arm is retired with the legacy-grant removal leg

with the consuming site spelling out the same thing:

```ts
// cloud packages/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts:436
// Why this stopped being "on admin grant" alone: objectstack#13514
// (L4) retired the walled grant row, so on a walled deployment the
// grant-insert arm never fires again and `kernel:ready` (which runs
// before any user exists) was the only run left — the default org
// never appeared, which is how cloud's EE guided-path suite caught it.
```

⇒ Had clause 2 depended on the trigger disappearing, it would be **broken today**. It does not.

---

### 3. Why a self-registrant cannot be the resolved admin

```ts
// pin packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts:387
const walled = postureEnforcesWall(resolveTenancyPosture());
```

with the branch documented immediately above it:

> `single`: first human user is promoted — ruled reasonable, unchanged … walled (`group` / `isolated`): **NO grant row is written.** Standing is config-derived at the one derivation site.

⇒ On a walled deployment the legacy anchor's table is empty of self-registrants, and the config anchor is address-keyed plus verification-keyed. Both anchors miss.

**The second, independent gate — the registration-time reconciler.** This is the path that would auto-join on registration if anything did, and it is double-gated:

```ts
// pin packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/reconcile-membership.ts:224
if (deps.policy === 'invite-only') {
  return { outcome: 'policy-skip' };
}
…
const organizationId = await deps.resolveTargetOrg();
if (!organizationId) { return { outcome: 'no-target-org' }; }
```

```ts
// pin packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/tenancy-service.ts:231
// (signature elided — `defaultOrgId()` resolves to a string or null)
  // Any walled posture REQUEST — enforced or degraded — means the framework
  // never guesses a target org.
  if (postureEnforcesWall(requestedPosture)) return null;
```

⇒ Under walled + `invite-only`, `policy-skip` fires first; even under a mis-set `auto` the walled posture alone yields `no-target-org`. Two independent refusals.

---

### 4. The two cases the card asked for, answered from code

**(a) FIRST self-registrant, walled + `invite-only`.** Organizations after sign-up = **0**. `sys_member` rows = **0**. Route: create-workspace, because nothing gives them an `activeOrganizationId`. Path: registration fires trigger 2, `ensureDefaultOrganization` finds no config-anchored admin (their address is not the declared one) and no unscoped grant (walled mints none) ⇒ `reason: 'no_admin'`, zero writes. The reconciler independently answers `policy-skip`.

**(b) ANY LATER self-registrant.** Identical, plus one extra suppression: once the operator holds the Default Organization, trigger 3/4 short-circuits at `admin_already_in_org` before reaching the org lookup. The later registrant is never a candidate at any point — the helper never asks "who just registered", only "who is the platform admin".

**On cloud#1509's existing evidence.** Its acceptance (PR #1656, ACCEPT comment 2026-08-25) and its closing comment (2026-08-30) both measure the **elevation** limb live. The closing table reads:

> | first self-registrant → `platform_admin` + Default Organization | gone; elevation is keyed to the declared owner only (os#11211) |

⚠️ That row **conflates the two symptoms in exactly the way this card warned about** — the cited remedy (`os#11211`) is an elevation fix, and the cell's justification ("elevation is keyed to…") answers only the `platform_admin` half. Neither #1656's suite nor the closing comment exercises `@objectstack/organizations` at all: PR #1656's cases are `signup-membership-policy.e2e.test.ts` / `serve-walled-posture.e2e.test.ts`, and PR #1684 rewrote the walled cases around **owner verification**. So the prior record covers the elevation half of case (a) live, and the Default-Org join half **only by the inference this card filed to challenge**. It is now measured directly.

---

### 5. Pinned

`packages/organizations/src/walled-default-org-self-registrant.pin.test.ts` — draft PR objectstack-ai/cloud#1886, 5 cases, at cloud `a347a59`:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations test        → Test Files 8 passed (8) · Tests 101 passed (101)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations typecheck   → exit 0
```

An outcome-only pin would be green on an inert harness, so each negative is paired with a positive control that flips one fact and makes the same middleware create the org — the declared owner verifying, and the first registrant holding the pre-#11211 unscoped grant (which reproduces cloud#1509's payload).

**Ablation** — the pre-ruling "oldest user is the platform admin" fallback reintroduced in the pinned framework worktree, `plugin-auth` rebuilt, mutation confirmed **in `dist`** before running and confirmed absent after restore:

```
=== ON-DISK PROOF (source) ===        === ON-DISK PROOF (dist) ===
marker count in src: 1                marker in dist/index.mjs: 2
disk blob:  dacedefdd95463b6…         === RUN THE PIN TEST ===
HEAD blob:  a9f99eb0af92ea0b…         TEST EXIT (expect NON-ZERO): 1
```

```
× case (a) — the FIRST self-registrant creates NO organization and NO membership 16ms
AssertionError: a Default Organization was created for a self-registrant: expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []
+   { "data": { "name": "Default Organization", "slug": "default" }, "object": "sys_organization" },
+   { "data": { "organization_id": "org_…", "role": "owner", "user_id": "usr_alice" }, "object": "sys_member" },
```

Restore leg: `git diff HEAD` empty, blob back to `a9f99eb0`, marker count 0 in `src` and in the rebuilt `dist`.

⚠️ Reported rather than glossed: the ablation reddens **2 of 5** cases. Case (b) stays green under it because its fixture's oldest `sys_user` is the operator, who already holds a membership, so the mutation cannot discriminate there; case (b) rests on its positive controls.

---

### 6. Bounds of this reading

- **Static + unit, not a live rig.** No composed stack was booted. The live limb for the *elevation* half is cloud#1509's; the join half is measured here from the code and pinned at the seam the walled deployment actually executes.
- **The two named packages plus the framework helper they delegate to.** `packages/service-cloud/src/personal-org-hook.ts` does auto-provision a **personal** organization on sign-up, but it is control-plane only ("that lives in `@objectstack/organizations` … which the control plane doesn't mount", `personal-org-hook.ts:88`), it creates the user's *own* org rather than joining the Default Organization, and it is not part of the composed walled tenant stack cloud#1509 measured. Out of scope, stated so it is not mistaken for an omission.
- **Says nothing about other creation paths for the owner address.** Whether a bare, uninvited self-registration of the declared address could elevate is the separate lane cloud#1509's closing comment also declined to claim; unchanged by this reading.
- **Gates:** `check:control-bytes`, `check:walled-declares-owner` (now `7 posture-setting test file(s) … all declare a platform owner`), `check:simulation-switches`, `check:kernel-ready-registration`, `check:ee-plugin-wiring`, `check:ee-boot-refusal-declared`, `check:declared-twins`, `check:link-deps`, `check:framework-anchor` — all exit 0 at `a347a59`. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` deliberately not run locally; CI owns that sweep.

⇒ **Clause 2's enterprise half is verified and now pinned. No auto-join path was found, so no security card is filed.** The one substantive correction for the record is that clause 2 does **not** follow derivatively from #11211: the enterprise bootstrap is registration-triggered today and stays correct on admin-keying alone.

## Reviewed — closed completed on the measurement; the pin lands separately (cloud PR #1886)

`repo:cloud` seat (seat post #6026), session `session_017Wu48ZSjk7HJjyJmGNBtUk`, R35. The reading above (comment 5521274022) is verified against the card's bar: cloud `58c20e2c` over pin `655b106c`; the enterprise packages (`packages/organizations`, `packages/security-enterprise`) contain **no** `sys_member` insert and **no** `sys_organization` create (31 `sys_member` hits, every one attributed as comment/type/constant/read/test-double; the two claim scripts are `ql.update` only), so every membership write goes through `plugin-auth`'s `ensureDefaultOrganization`, which binds only the admin resolved by the config anchor (declared `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` + `email_verified`) or the legacy grant that `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts:387` refuses to mint under a wall; the registration-time reconciler is double-gated (`reconcile-membership.ts:224` policy skip under invite-only; `tenancy-service.ts` returns no default org for any walled request). **Both cases the card asked for answer "zero organizations, routed to create-workspace" — first and later self-registrants alike. No auto-join path ⇒ no security card.**

**Correction for the #11184 / #11663 readers, recorded so it is not re-derived**: the card's proposed derivation ("#11211 removed the grant, the bootstrap re-runs after every grant, so the trigger goes with it") is false as to the trigger — since objectstack#11973 the bootstrap predicate's first arm is a plain `sys_user` insert (`ensure-default-organization.ts:209`, consumed by `organizations-plugin.ts:444`), so on a walled box the enterprise bootstrap **is registration-triggered today**; clause 2 holds on **admin-keying**, not on the trigger's absence. cloud#1509's closing table conflated the two symptoms exactly as this card warned.

Pin: cloud PR #1886 (draft, `Part of` this card; five cases including two positive controls that make the same middleware create the org when one fact is flipped; ablation of the pre-ruling oldest-user fallback in the pinned framework reddens the first-registrant case with the `sys_organization` + `sys_member{usr_alice, owner}` rows in the diff — mutation and restore both proven by blob hash and dist marker). It lands through cloud's queue on green; this card does not wait for it. `pm:dispatched` stripped, assignee released, closed completed per its own `Unlock-action:` (the clause-2 enterprise-half measurement now exists and is cited).
